investigation_notes.Description: An encoded PowerShell command was executed on MEETINGROOM-01 under NT AUTHORITY\SYSTEM and spawned by powershell.exe with parent svchost.exe; the executed script maps to an on-disk module under Program Files. VirusTotal returned no detections for the initiating process SHA256, and there were no recent related events or similar alerts found in the environment. Given the on-disk module location, system-level execution context, benign VT result, and lack of historical matches, the activity is assessed as low priority as it aligns with expected maintenance/utility behavior.
